headline: Deputies recommend approving second supplementary budget
summary: A special committee of deputies recommended approval of the second supplementary budget for 2026 after a single three-hour meeting. The report was backed by the ruling party's majority, without opposition support.
why: Supplementary budgets change government spending authority mid-year, affecting fiscal deficits and public borrowing needs.
original_headline: Diputados recomiendan aprobar segundo presupuesto complementario
